correctness.rationale: Independent constant-term computation of ((z^{-1}+2+z)/4)^n gives c_n=binom(2n,n)/4^n. Distinct children and disjoint proposition pairs are independent, yielding an exact binomial upper tail. Stirling shows nc_n^k~pi^{-k/2}n^{1-k/2}; Chebyshev, binomial Poisson convergence, Markov give 1, Poi(1/pi) tail, 0. At the explicit zero-substitution recursion, the inner limit zero forces outer recursive value zero. Direct leaf enumeration n≤5 corroborated the probability. The assertion of refuting the source Conjecture 38 is conditional on its original fixed-full-branching convention, which could not be reverified from inaccessible full text.
